description: Fischer-Tropsch LTFT reactor with part-load PLR correction, ASF alpha temperature dependence, exothermic heat integration, and catalyst deactivation.

unit.name: Generic LTFT Co/Al2O3 Reactor, 200-230 degC, 20-30 bar, with heat recovery
unit.source: Dry (2002) Catalysis Today; Hillestad et al. (2018) Chem. Eng. J., 364, 520-531; De Klerk (2011) Wiley.

X_max.note: Max per-pass CO conversion at design

alpha_k_per_K.note: Alpha change per K temperature (lower T → higher alpha → more wax, negative sign means alpha increases as T drops below T_opt)

LHV_FT_kJ_mol.note: LHV of C12 surrogate jet fuel

f_recovery.note: Heat recovery fraction (60%: pre-heat feed + steam to rWGS)

PLR_coeffs.note: Quadratic PLR correction [a0,a1,a2]; normalized so sum=1 at PLR=1. Represents ~10% conversion drop at PLR=0.5.

dT_cold_K.note: Bed temperature drop at PLR→0 (less exotherm at low throughput, Hillestad 2018)

k_deact_per_1000h.note: Co catalyst deactivation rate: ~0.8% per 1000h (sintering+coking, Dry 2002 range: 0.5-1.5%/1000h)
